instruction_prefix: Read the supplied text in full without adding or omitting words or inserting filler sounds. Use clear, natural mainland Mandarin and maintain a mature, full, resonant male voice. Keep a brisk conversational pace, connecting words within thought groups. Move lightly through secondary words, give key words brief, decisive emphasis, and avoid stretching vowels.
instruction_suffix: Speak as if explaining an idea clearly to a friend. Vary emphasis naturally; do not declaim, shout, or pause after every word.

approved_sample.direction: After introducing the question, pause only briefly and ask it naturally. Contrast “不生气” with “没见过.” Land “差得很远” decisively and give “不愿意” weight. Near the end, place slightly more emphasis on “真正” to lead into the final point, “拒绝.” Move naturally through connecting words.
